assumptions.choice: The opening range uses bars timestamped 09:30 through 09:34 ET; ORB crossover state begins at 09:35 and entries are allowed from 09:35 onward.
assumptions.reason: This treats 09:30-09:35 as the first five one-minute bars and implements the stated post-range condition.

assumptions.choice: Feed timestamps are treated as ET.
assumptions.reason: The supplied feed is specified in ET and no timezone conversion is available or required.

assumptions.choice: Cumulative daily loss uses closed-trade net P&L including commission, compared with 0.5% of the strategy's initial broker value.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define whether unrealized P&L, commissions, or a changing capital base are included.

assumptions.choice: When both long and short signals occur on one bar, long has precedence; otherwise signals are evaluated in stated order without requiring confirmation from another signal.
assumptions.reason: The signals are specified as independent, but no conflict-resolution rule is given.

assumptions.choice: Stop and target orders are submitted immediately after the market entry fills, using its actual executed price and paired with OCO behavior.
assumptions.reason: A Backtrader market order's fill price is unavailable at signal time; this is the closest literal implementation of levels exactly 1% and 2% from entry price.
